name: semantic_knowledge_xl
research_question: Does better semantic knowledge make DREAM's object search faster than frontier exploration in LARGER homes, without costing correctness?
evidence_class: held-out (fresh runner seeds 9300-9303, never used by any config or result in the repository; development used runner seeds 100-103 only, with the xl generator, which did not exist before this workstream)
rule3_class: No result-affecting algorithmic change to the agent: new selectable knowledge sources (default unchanged), a new environment (xl generator, document as such), and a new analysis. The planner constants, kappa = 3 and the verifier are frozen.
labels: Odometry is ORACLE-ASSISTED (true increments plus noise, gyro bias std 0.002 rad/s, as dream/sim/g1_mobile.py).
The semantic detector is ORACLE-ASSISTED: rendered segmentation plus an ASSUMED, uncalibrated noise model (dream/sim/semantic_sensor.py); NOMINAL.
The base is the KINEMATIC SURROGATE (dream/sim/kinematic_base.py: no legged dynamics, no falls).

Room-type knowledge: ConceptNet 5.7 extract (third_party/household_knowledge) and/or the saved Qwen3-VL-4B text-only room priors (results/qwen_room_priors, elicited with a prompt that holds only the object name and the extract's place vocabulary). Both are uncalibrated association weights, not probabilities.

CAVEAT: the generator's furnishing tables and the evaluation were written by the same author, so agreement of a knowledge source with those tables can inflate its benefit; scenario D (atypical placement) and E (target absent) are the check against that.

The xl generator is a NEW ENVIRONMENT (dream/sim/home.py, generator 'xl'): 12 rooms in a 4 x 3 grid (13.0-14.5 m by 10.0-11.5 m), every room type the generator knows plus extra bedrooms and bathrooms, nominal furnishing tables and object scales, the nominal doorway logic.
Requests are read by the explicit grammar (dream/tools/intent.py); no language model runs in these episodes.
Qwen numerical guard: raw scores are floored at 0.01 before normalising (log of a zero ratio is undefined); no other scaling, temperature or tuned weight.
time_budget_reason: Development check (results/semantic_knowledge_xl/dev_budget, runner seeds 100-103, 64 target-present xl homes): A_frontier found 58/64 = 90.6% within 600 s, above the 80% threshold, so the budget stays 600 s. Decided from dev seeds only.

A_frontier_point._note: classical gain-frontier explorer with the old verifier (point purity rule)

A_frontier._note: gain-frontier explorer, current verifier (Wilson lower bound); the reference arm

sem_none._note: utility planner, uniform knowledge: information gain and inspection points only

sem_conceptnet._note: the proposed utility planner as in H1-H4 and V1 (ConceptNet 5.7 extract)

sem_qwen._note: same planner; priors and room inference from results/qwen_room_priors

sem_combined._note: same planner; equal-weight mixture of ConceptNet and Qwen per class

dev_budget._note: DEVELOPMENT ONLY (runner seeds 100-103): the pre-declared budget rule. A_frontier on xl homes, scenarios B and D, 8 targets x 4 seeds = 64 target-present homes.

dev_smoke._note: DEVELOPMENT ONLY (runner seed 101): all six arms on xl homes, scenarios B, D, E, four targets: crash check, per-episode timing, room-inference accuracy per knowledge source.

K1._note: fresh runner seeds 9300-9303: xl generator, kinematic base, NOMINAL detector, scenarios B, D, E x 8 targets x 4 seeds = 96 homes; 6 arms = 576 episodes

gates._note: Pre-registered before any K1 episode is run. Counts are over valid episodes (crashes and scene failures reported separately, never counted as passes). Evaluated by experiments/semantic_knowledge_gates.py.
gates.K-G1: safety: every arm using the current verifier makes 0 false success claims in K1 (each arm's count is reported with its zero-event 95% upper bound)
gates.K-G2: primary, confirmatory: on target-present episodes (scenarios B and D, 64 pairs per comparison), each of sem_conceptnet, sem_qwen, sem_combined against A_frontier: time to verified find, one-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test with time censored at the budget for misses (the same censoring as the existing analysis), Holm-Bonferroni across the three comparisons at family alpha 0.05. A comparison passes if its adjusted p < 0.05 AND the median paired difference is negative.
gates.K-G3: non-inferiority of success: each semantic arm's target-present successes >= A_frontier's - 3, paired
gates.K-G4: descriptive: sem_qwen vs sem_conceptnet and sem_combined vs sem_qwen (two-sided Wilcoxon, McNemar), per-scenario breakdown (B vs D: knowledge should help B and may hurt D), path length, correct refusal on E, A_frontier_point vs A_frontier false claims, per-target results, room-inference accuracy per knowledge source (top-1 per room type, as the README reports for ConceptNet)

seed_hygiene: Seeds 9000-9019 (vision.json), 9100, 9200-9205 and 9500+ are used by other experiments. The block 9300-9303 was chosen after grepping every config under experiments/configs and every result under results/ for seed fields; none uses 9300-9303. Development used runner seeds 100-103 only.
